answers.core:
We already support Adaptive Icons and Themed Icons is part of it.
By adding this Godot will also to encourage the right Android customization support.
answers.workaround: If not used, all we have to do is omit the `<monochrome android:drawable="@mipmap/icon_monochrome"/>` line and it will work as is today.

title: Add support for Android Themed Icons
